limits: Exact directEnemy source fairyA, CEL enFairy(Clone), motion renderer enFairy01 and source renderer 121395 only. This archive grants no inheritance to another fairy source or renderer topology.

The native pass action preserved enemy HP58 and reduced hero HP from 995 to 991 while recording AttackProf, fairy_attackProf, damage 4 and Damaged. This is sampled native gameplay under the survival fixture, not a balance claim.

The first ordinary zero-focus attack used the native bluntSmithHammer without a skill cap or damage fixture and produced native Dodge with enemy HP unchanged at 58, followed by fairy_dodge. Two later fairy_attackProf sequences each dealt 4 damage to the hero, changing hero HP from 991 to 983.

The second ordinary zero-focus native hammer attack reduced Moonreed from 58 to 55 HP with recorded damage 3, a Damaged response and fairy_damaged. A later fairy_attackProf recorded zero damage and native Dodge against the hero.
The explicit KillSingle fixture reduced Moonreed from 55 to 0 HP with recorded native 1000 damage and a Death trigger. It is fixture death evidence, not ordinary lethal gameplay.

The source has m_DoRagdoll false. The animator remains enabled while fairy_die persists from frame 26 through frame 119. The two recorded nonkinematic rigid bodies are inactive break props and receive no ragdoll credit.

All four captures retain the requested 120 frames. The exact renderer remains active, enabled, reported visible and identity-stable through all 480 frames. The sampled animated death remains present through frame 119, but this boundary does not establish general corpse lifetime, cleanup causality or final disposal.
One guarded native Collect action succeeded and strict Ready succeeded at dungeon level 0, room 2, with one active Ready button.

Thirty selected original PNGs were reviewed. Native effects, foreground hero overlap, the small native presentation, fixed-camera perspective, loot UI and late depth blur limit fine inspection in stated frames; the remaining 450 capture PNGs are preserved by hash but were not individually reviewed.

The profile preserves native CEL scale 1.0. Its Standard matFairyA material uses the authored moonreed_basecolor.png main texture with emission disabled, zero emission color and no emission map. This route does not establish portrait pixels, other cameras, other resolutions or all-angle culling.

This isolated dungeon trial does not prove every fairy animation, collision, alternate materials, long-session resource lifetime, inheritance to another fairy source, full campaign progression or finished-art acceptance.
